name: aleph
description: Connect Aleph to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Aleph MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Aleph to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with financial data for FP&A using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Aleph workspace.
Find anything in Aleph that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review financial data for FP&A in Aleph.
